  •  Unrefined, cold pressed, raw Coconut Oil – which provides antioxidants and skin healing properties.

​Hi! My name's Cherelle and I decided to create Teeny Wishes in the hope to create a fun variety of illustrations and greeting cards for children of colour. 

​I was sick and tired of getting my nephew a plain old boring Birthday or Christmas card. I wanted to get Lijy Pops (Elijah) a card with a cartoon representation of himself but could not find a variety of these cards  anywhere. . . for 4 whole years.

Like many others I believe it is incredibly important for children to see a representation of themselves, whether in cartoon form or reality. 

I have a growing range of fun, colourful greeting cards all printed and handmade in the UK.

description:

These illustrations primarily depict kinky, coily, curly and wavy women in their element.

They are minimal but yet powerful.

Most of the images have been named after a song they were created to. The meanings of each piece is what you interpret but if you're curious as to the original sentiment, have a listen!

name: Elewa ltd
description:
Elewa is a business just started by 3 women all of whom share a love for fine clothing, jewellery and related items. We also share a love of African print.

Our original concept centered around wrap clothing. Wrap clothing allows for people of different sizes to wear the same garment and look equally great as the garment gives to the shape of the person wearing it. The first garment we have focused on is the wrap skirt.

THE WRAP SKIRTS
Our wrap skirts have been made after extensive customer research which indicated firstly the love for wrap clothing and also ways in which they wanted the garment made. We have incorporated these ideas into the skirt we have designed and made and we believe therefore that these skirts will look great on persons within the given size range 10 - 16.

name: A Touch By Bex
description:
Welcome to A Touch By Bex, we sell a range of personalised gifts and cards. Our apparel, earrings and greeting cards are inspired by Africa and our black kings and queens. We also sell personalised Champagne and Gin glasses and will be expanding the personalised gift range soon.

We also offer custom services and professional branding.

name: Osime Home
description:
Osime Home is an online shop specialising in African-inspired home and lifestyle accessories. Bold and brimming with character I offer a selection of quality limited-run cushion covers (for now, but watch this space, there's more to come) in various African prints designed to instantly inject colour, uplift your mood and make everyday living a little brighter.

The name Osime [pronounced OH - SI- MEH] originates from the Esan tribe (Edo, Benin state) in the Southern part of Nigeria, meaning ‘This is my own. It reminds me of home, my culture, it’s warmth and vibrancy one which always brings me joy. Born and raised in the UK, growing up my home was a treasure-trove of African textiles, accessories and products that reminded me of my cultural heritage.

Osime Home was established in October 2017. After buying my first home with my husband I struggled to find home decor that celebrated African design, textiles and that reflected my vibrant African community, which is a big part of my identity. So I began making and creating my own African-inspired accessories and well, here we are.

name: Doria Adouke
description:
My name is Doria, I am a French illustrator based in London, UK.
My work is inspired by a mix of various cultures influenced by my travels.
Through my illustrations, my goal is mainly to celebrate black women as they are not well-represented in the medias.
All the illustrations are handmade by me and unique.
My art is based on mixed-media (pencil, graphic design, photography and watercolour).
Even if I opened a shop back in 2003, I actually started to add products on Etsy on December 2020 :)

name: Prints By Zawedde
description:
PrintsByZawedde is a personal collection of prints by me, Margaret Zawedde. Creatively increasing visibility of the Black British African LGBTQ+ woman. A majority of my art pieces were created during Lockdown, that spare time came in handy! Artistically, my Ugandan heritage inspires the style and colours seen in my art with the continued fusion through an African Diaspora perspective.

Buying my prints stays kind to the evnironment. All printed paper seen are created with recycled materials and has an uncoated matt/rough finish.

name: Shai Digital
description:
as a self taught artist MY WORK is centered around MY passion for storytelling combined with my Ghanaian + British culture. I create the type of artwork i dreamed of seeing growing up, as i rarely saw art / artists that looked like me. Each piece vibrantly embodies different aspects of black culture and our experiences alongside fantasy and celestial components.

​

part of my motivation to create is to help break the stigma around creative jobs, as they are often not accepted as a career path choice within our community. if my art can inspire or encourage at least one person to pursue their talent, then i've fulfilled a portion of my purpose as an artist.

name: Continent Clo
description:
Continent Clothing brings you the very best in street style and festival-wear created using vibrant and geometric traditional African Wax Print fabrics.

Feel good in our clothing... Knowing that every purchase directly helps to improve the lives of others in West Africa.

All our clothing is designed by us and made in The Gambia with fabrics sourced from merchants across West Africa. Our aim is to provide full time and sustainable employment to as many people as possible in West Africa. We work on a micro scale and work directly with local Gambian tailors, seamstresses and fabric merchants in Ghana, Senegal and Cote Du Voir.

We take great pride in our products, for how they are made, by whom and why. Your purchases and support has value far beyond the cost of an item of clothing. Our socially responsible projects employ over 60 people in West Africa to earn a good living, send their children to school or to pay for health care and other necessities. We actively try to minimise our impact on the environment too. All our packaging is recycled and plastic free. Many of our jewellery products minimise waste by using the waste material from our clothing collection. Working towards a zero waste business is extremely important to us and we will continue to try to achieve this.

We love what we do and whom we work with. We shout about it all the time. Just read our product names…. They’re all named after the tailor who produced them. Much more on this can be found on our website and social media channels.

We were always able to find other races represented on bags, t-shirts lunch bags or even notebooks, but never anything that looked like my daughter. I wanted her to look around and see positive representations of herself and people that looked like her and no matter where I looked for it, it somehow was not that easy to find a British based company.

name: Ibere Apparel
description:
IBERE APPAREL was created to enable us to proudly and publicly Celebrate Black History and Culture 365 days a Year! Our brand is for everyone - we have a wide variety of products from Mugs, to T-Shirts, to Pins, Stickers, Cards, Stationary and more! With our products, you will have so many ways to express your pride in your history & culture, as well as to remind yourself and others of your greatness, each and every day!

IBERE APPAREL is here to tell the world: We don’t need a particular day to love one another, we don’t need a particular day to remember who we are. We are Black 365 days a year, so let’s Celebrate Black History and Culture 365 days a Year!

name: Stacey Ann Cole Art
description: I opened my Etsy shop because I had a strong desire to create Black, Afrocentric art, share and make it readily available to those who craved to see themselves represented, like I did. I love creating my original artwork piece and I do sell these too but it was also important to me to reproduce my work in carefully selected formats so that it was affordable to a wide range of people, such as my greeting cards and notebooks.

name: Bespoke Diva Shop
description:
Bespoke Diva was born from the frustration I felt when shopping for greeting cards that represented the diversity of my family, friends.

I started with a small range of designs, which my nearest and dearest loved receiving on occasions such as birthdays, weddings, Christmas. I was so thrilled and touched when witnessing their reaction to cards that were not only personalised for them but also represented them.
When I started to become inundated with requests, I knew it was time to turn my love for designing personalised greeting cards into a fully fledged business for people of all ages and races to enjoy.
Bespoke Diva greeting cards are fun, fierce and fabulous… just like me.

name: Adia Nature
description: We are a small team of two, both with a love for all things skincare and a desire to build a skincare empire from all-natural products and vegan ingredients. Although we are a small team, we are no less determined and we bounce off each other’s energies, creating the perfect partnership.We are completely dedicated to our brand and providing you with premium skincare that is not only all-natural but is cruelty-free. One of the biggest motivations for our brand was the number of brands still testing on animals. We vow to give you access to products that aren’t only incredible for the skin but incredible to the fate of animals.Our business was finally born after months of experiments with essential oils and nutrients. From Cedarwood to cocoa seed we wanted to combine every botanical and antioxidant-rich ingredient to make the highest quality products from the natural gold mines we have all around us. We believe we have found the best concoction of amazing and gentle ingredients and we have many more exciting products in the pipeline.

Black to royaltys vision has self-love, black unity and fashion-centered at its core, and all of my products reflect these ideals

The sole purpose of my brand is to push and promote Black empowerment and Black unity. The mission itself is in the name. 'Black To Royalty' I try to remind our people that we are a unique Royal nation and that we need to return to our original state. name: Sunkissed Beauty Bar
description:
Sunkissed Beauty Bar is a sister owned business based in London, United Kingdom. Growing up, we spent most of our summers in Ghana. We fell in love with the abundance of natural ingredients that surrounded us including Aloe vera, coconuts, shea trees, cocoa and more! We very quickly saw the benefits to our skin from using natural ingredients in comparison to the harsher products we were using back home. Spots were clearing up, our skin was cleaner and more refreshed, our skin looked more even and radiant, we were glowing, we were 'Sunkissed'.

We since studied the arts of skincare, perfumery and aromatherapy to deepen our skills. We are in love with enhancing, cleansing, helpful and effective ingredients and use this to create products to bring out natural beauty as well as offering pampering, relaxation, luxurious at home experiences and feel good moments! Healthy skin is beautiful skin and our products aim to restore happiness, cleanliness and joy back to your skin and pampering routine.

The everyday stresses of life can overwhelm us and it is important to pause to make time for yourself and self-care. For us, aromatherapy plays a big part in this due to its ability to improve both physical and psychological wellbeing. We love mixing pure, aromatic essential oils with natural ingredients to create luxurious and pampering products.

We believe that Healthy skin is beautiful skin and our products aim to restore happiness, life, cleanliness and joy back to your skin and pampering routine.

Beauty, Pampering & Happiness.

name: Ahima Jewellery
description:
As a jewellery designer and maker, I draw inspiration from different cultures from Africa and within Ghana, to hand make a range of individually meaningful fine jewellery in sterling silver, 18ct gold and rose gold vermeil.

Inspired by my Ghanaian heritage, I use the symbols of wisdom, strength, truth, virtue and grace that have for centuries underpinned and been used to pass on the essential life-guiding principles of the Ashanti people of Ghana. Ahima Jewellery subtly imbues such emblems with fine fashion design and colour to form unique pieces for the modern woman.

Each design is painstakingly handcrafted in my North London studio, so that whether a gift or a special treat for yourself, when you buy an Ahima Jewellery you can be certain that it’s a beautiful timeless piece of the highest quality, individually hand finished and infused with both love and tradition.
I hope you love your jewellery as much as I enjoyed making it for you.

Fikre Kitchen prepares and sells authentic homemade Ethiopian vegan food.
We are a family business, celebrating our Ethiopian culture through traditional rich vegan recipes.
The name Fikre originates from Ethiopia meaning ‘my love.’ We use this concept to share our love of Ethiopian traditional food and cultural heritage.
Fikre is also the name of the amazing chef and matriarch behind the dishes we prepare, serve and sell.

Eko Restaurant is the place for Nigerian food, great atmosphere and good music, every Friday and Saturday night we have live bands entertaining. If you need to entertain guests, you have a celebration, you want to bubble, you want to chill or you are hungry and you want to chop proper naija food this is the place to be.

BAME Skincare is the first clinical grade skincare line dedicated to skin of colour, created by doctors and cosmetic chemists.

They  are an inclusive skincare brand which provides safe and effective solutions for the skin conditions that affect us most. They are here to revolutionise the way skincare is delivered to people of colour by providing a one stop shop of online and in-person clinic services, consumer and professional products and a teaching academy.

name: Jamaica Patty Co (Covent Garden)
description:
Jamaica Patty Co. was founded in 2013 with the aim of bringing high-quality Jamaican food to the UK. Frustrated by her inability to find the flavours and aromas of straight from the oven patties in London, Jamaican-born entrepreneur Theresa Roberts decided to launch Jamaica Patty Co. in order to give UK consumers the opportunity to enjoy the fresh
flavour of Jamaica.
To ensure authenticity all recipes have been developed by renowned Jamaican chef Collin Brown and Theresa; Collin insists that every single patty is freshly baked in store just like they are in Jamaica.

name: Hot N Juicy Shrimp LDN

Eat Hearty and Enjoy your Meal!

Their premium range of products is now stocked nationwide in Sainsbury’s, Liberty London, ASOS and Debenhams.
address: Urbxne Limited, 1st Floor Helthaid House, Marlborough Hill

name: Akra Designs
description:
Akra Designs has been established since 2006. They specialise in authentic handmade products for home and Fashion accessories. Akra are a retail and wholesale business based in the UK.  They have supported and encouraged creative designers in Ghana for the past 15 years.

The idea came about whilst The Owner, Eva was in Ghana. Being Ghanaian she felt that this was an opportunity to help support Ghanaians and make their work available to a wider audience who would appreciate the creativity and authenticity of their designs. Akra’s mission is to create a social purpose enterprise that creates positive impact in local Ghanaian communities.

name: Ananse Arts
description:
Ananse Arts is an Arts and Production Company offering high quality Theatrical, Performance and Video services for Individual, Corporate and Educational organisations. Ananse Arts specialises in providing Caribbean and African cultural expression through the Arts. We are now rolling out a range of Animation, Film & TV, Dance, Performance and Storytelling workshops for Children, Youth and Adults.

Come and Find us to know more about what we can offer you, your company or organisation!

name: The Afrikan Cooperative Union
description:
ACU) is an FCA regulated entity in the UK, registration number (31807R).

As an organisation it is focused on bringing like-minded people together from our community to cooperate in achieving mutual benefits by pooling our financial resources and knowledge.

Mutual benefits can be for-profit or non-Profit. It can be nation building activities, investing in people, entrepreneurs, businesses and or community projects that solve problems, create jobs and create inter-generational wealth for our members or the community at large.

Its business footprint can be worldwide or anywhere its members deem it ethical to engage in business.

Ceetish wigs and hair bundles are unparalleled in comfort and natural appearance. Ceetish focuses on details – from the hair material to the cap size to the color charts and many more. Every product is carefully designed and produced to ensure the most beautiful look, natural movement and comfortable fit. we only stock the best human & synthetic hair along with a wide selection of wigs. Every one of our stunning wigs and bundles is available online and ready to be delivered to your door wherever you are in the world. Our human hair extensions are all 100% raw virgin hair, double drawn and salon-quality.

name: Ilho Sunshine
description:
Ilhora-Lee Louison, 8 years-old girl and her mum Jessica Louison, have co-written a self-development journal to help young people to deal with their emotions and develop a positive mindset.

Ilhora-Lee has experienced stress, sadness, loneliness, anger, lack of confidence, and misunderstandings and as a result she decided to use the power of Journaling through her Self-development Journal to support young people’s development and help them learn strategies to improve their self-belief and self-esteem.

Thanks to Ilho Sunshine Self-Development Journal, young people have fun discovering their potential and meeting the best version of themselves when transitioning from childhood to adulthood.

Kutivz Kollection is a brand that has you covered for all your beauty needs, getting you fully ready for any occasion. From make-up, to lashes, to jewellery and hair, we can take you from day fabulous to night glam.

name: Merky Bikes
description:
MerkyBikes is a UK based, black independent family business specialising in the online supply of electric bikes

We have partnered with a highly experienced e-bike manufacturer to design and create a diverse range of models to suit a variety of needs and abilities.

We believe that pedal assisted riding is the future of domestic travel with many benefits to both riders and of course the environment. At MerkyBikes we pride ourselves on making e-biking accessible for all with bikes that are supremely built, using the highest quality parts, at very competitive and affordable prices.

Our conviction is that Merkybikes, and the people that ride them, live at the intersection of energy and consciousness with complete awareness of our responsibility and connection to our planet

name: Native Fragrance
description:

All products are handmade in small batches with high quality ingredients infused with exquisite scents responsibly sourced from ethical manufacturers and suppliers. Be rest assured that all the products created are made with natural, vegan friendly and free from paraffin and other toxins ingredients ensuring eco friendly and sustainable products every time.

Regardless of what scent you choose from Native Fragrance, I aim to provide you with a sense of wonder, peace and tranquility with every sniff.
